json_schema.title: Schema
json_schema.description: A complete schema suitable for generators in any language.

format_version.description: Interchange format version (independent of Telegram's layer).

layer.description: Telegram API layer advertised by the source.

value.description: Ordinary value or repeated field group.

ArgumentValue.description: The mutually exclusive forms of a combinator argument.

oneOf.description: One value with a TL type expression.

expression.description: Parsed expression; never a schema-name placeholder.

oneOf.description: A bracketed group repeated according to a natural expression.

multiplicity.description: Count expression, or the preceding natural argument when omitted.

id.description: Resolved constructor number (explicit or canonical CRC32).

id_explicit.description: Whether the source supplied the number instead of relying on canonical CRC32.

id_hex.description: Hex form convenient for languages with awkward unsigned integers.

layer.description:
Layer known for this declaration. Current flat schemas only identify the
containing layer and cannot prove an earlier introduction layer.

official_url.description: Official Telegram documentation page inferred from the declaration kind.

oneOf.description: Natural addition supported by the TL formal grammar.

introduced.description: First layer, only when the input explicitly provides it.

parameters.edit_date: Last edit date of this message
parameters.edit_hide: Whether the message should be shown as not modified to the user, even if an edit date is present
parameters.effect: A message effect that should be played as specified here » .
parameters.from_boosts_applied: Supergroups only, contains the number of boosts this user has given the current supergroup, and should be shown in the UI in the header of the message. Only present for incoming messages from non-anonymous supergroup members that have boosted the supergroup. Note that this counter should be locally overridden for non-anonymous outgoing messages, according to the current value of channelFull . boosts_applied , to ensure the value is correct even for messages sent by the current user before a supergroup was boosted (or after a boost has expired or the number of boosts has changed); do not update this value for incoming messages from other users, even if their boosts have changed.
parameters.from_id: ID of the sender of the message
parameters.from_rank: Only in supergroups » (never basic groups, where this information is contained elsewhere » ), contains the sender's tag » .
parameters.from_scheduled: Whether this is a scheduled message
parameters.grouped_id: Multiple media messages sent using messages.sendMultiMedia with the same grouped ID indicate an album or media group
parameters.guestchat_via_from: If the message was posted by a guest bot » , the peer on whose behalf the bot sent the message.
parameters.invert_media: If set, any eventual webpage preview will be shown on top of the message instead of at the bottom.
parameters.legacy: This is a legacy message: it has to be refetched with the new layer
parameters.media_unread: Whether there are unread media attachments in this message, see here » for more info on how to clear this flag.
parameters.mentioned: Whether we were mentioned in this message
parameters.noforwards: Whether this message is protected and thus cannot be forwarded; clients should also prevent users from saving attached media (i.e. videos should only be streamed, photos should be kept in RAM, et cetera).
parameters.offline: If set, the message was sent because of a scheduled action by the message sender, for example, as away, or a greeting service message.
parameters.paid_message_stars: The amount of stars the sender has paid to send the message, see here » for more info.
parameters.paid_suggested_post_stars: Set if this is a suggested channel post » that was paid using Telegram Stars .
parameters.paid_suggested_post_ton: Set if this is a suggested channel post » that was paid using Grams.
parameters.peer_id: Peer ID, the chat where this message was sent
parameters.post: Whether this is a channel post
parameters.post_author: Name of the author of this message for channel posts (with signatures enabled)
parameters.quick_reply_shortcut_id: If set, this message is a quick reply shortcut message » (note that quick reply shortcut messages sent to a private chat will not have this field set).
parameters.replies: Info about post comments (for channels) or message replies (for groups)
parameters.report_delivery_until_date: Used for Telegram Gateway verification messages : if set and the current unixtime is bigger than the specified unixtime, invoke messages.reportMessagesDelivery passing the ID and the peer of this message as soon as it is received by the client (optionally batching requests for the same peer).
parameters.restriction_reason: Contains the reason why access to this message must be restricted.
parameters.saved_peer_id: Messages from a saved messages dialog » will have peer = inputPeerSelf and the saved_peer_id flag set to the ID of the saved dialog. Messages from a monoforum » will have peer =ID of the monoforum and the saved_peer_id flag set to the ID of a topic.
parameters.schedule_repeat_period: Once sent, this message will be automatically re-scheduled to be re-sent again this many seconds in the future, see here » for more info on repeating scheduled messages.
parameters.silent: Whether this is a silent message (no notification triggered)
parameters.suggested_post: Used to suggest a post to a channel, see here » for more info on the full flow.
parameters.summary_from_language: If set, clients should offer a summarization button » for this message; contains the two-letter ISO 639-1 language code of the inferred language of the current message.
parameters.ttl_period: Time To Live of the message, once message.date+message.ttl_period === time(), the message will be deleted on the server, and must be deleted locally as well.
parameters.via_bot_id: ID of the inline bot that generated the message
parameters.via_business_bot_id: Whether the message was sent by the business bot specified in via_bot_id on behalf of the user.
parameters.video_processing_pending: The video contained in the message is currently being processed by the server (i.e. to generate alternative qualities, that will be contained in the final messageMediaDocument . alt_document ), and will be sent once the video is processed, which will happen approximately at the specified date (i.e. messages with this flag set should be treated similarly to scheduled messages , but instead of the scheduled date, date contains the estimated conversion date). See here » for more info.
